title: Chaos ore
description: A fun mod that adds a ore that drops random stuff!
body:
🎲 Chaos Ore

A lightweight, exciting mod that adds a chaotic twist to your mining adventures! 

Have you ever gotten tired of breaking ores and knowing *exactly* what you are going to get? Say goodbye to predictable mining. **Chaos Ore** turns every block broken into a high-stakes gamble!

### ✨ Features

* **The Chaos Ore:** A mysterious new ore block that can be found while exploring.

* **Dungeon-Style Drops:** Breaking this ore instantly rolls random loot pulled straight from vanilla dungeon chests. 

* **The Grand Prize:** Will you walk away with rare music discs, golden apples, name tags... or just some gun powder? Every break is a complete surprise!

### ⛏️ How to Play

1. Explore your world and find a **Chaos Ore** block.

2. Break it using your pickaxe.

3. Collect your random dungeon rewards!
